summary: tdbg m list-db command fails with UUID validation error in Temporal v1.30+, preventing cluster member enumeration from database.
userImpact: Cluster operators cannot list cluster members using tdbg tool after upgrading to v1.30, blocking cluster management operations.
rootCause: Empty host ID parameter passed during cluster member listing triggers UUID validation error introduced in PR #8541.
proposedFix: Fix implemented in PR #10133 to handle empty host ID parameter in cluster member listing.
keyQuote: Error: unable to list Cluster Members: rpc error: code = InvalidArgument desc = host ID "" is not a valid UUID: invalid UUID length: 0
